team_name: HTML to Sage WP Team - تیم تبدیل HTML به قالب وردپرس Sage
description: تیم ۱۴ نفره‌ی تبدیل قالب‌های HTML استاتیک به قالب وردپرس استاندارد با معماری Sage 11 بدون Composer؛ خروجی: قالب ریسپانسیو برای هر حوزه‌ی کاری با Lighthouse بالای ۹۰، سئوی حرفه‌ای، آنالیز رقبای فارسی و غیرفارسی، افزونه‌های داخلی، بازبینی مستقل UI/UX و تصاویر/مدیا بهینه (پک آیکون + تصاویر مرتبط)

hard_requirements.framework: Sage 11 style architecture without Composer (no composer.json, no vendor/)
hard_requirements.engine: strong processing engine in app/Engine/: Compiler (cached) + Container + Pipeline + Events; warm-cache compile overhead <= 5ms
hard_requirements.settings_panel: Theme Settings page with 7 tabs: header, footer, store control, pages, seo, performance/speed, updates (patch) — implemented per standards/theme-settings-standard.md (single option key, schema as single source of truth, empty = default)
hard_requirements.theme_updates: patch-based update via patches/manifest.json (sha256 verify, backup before apply, capability+nonce, staging in uploads/, log + rollback, max 20MB / 400 files)
hard_requirements.font: IRANSans (bundled at assets/fonts/iransans/, source: Google Drive IRANSans(FaNum).zip), font-display: swap, --font-sans: IRANSans
hard_requirements.footer_credit: footer must show 'مجموعه فناوری اطلاعات آمل نوین' linking to https://amolnovin.ir (non-removable default)
hard_requirements.naming: theme name = brand + 'نوین' (e.g. سایانا نوین); slug/text domain = {brand}-novin
hard_requirements.performance: Lighthouse >= 90 (mobile and desktop), LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1
hard_requirements.seo: professional: meta map, domain Schema.org, heading hierarchy, Persian SEO
hard_requirements.settings_standard: standards/theme-settings-standard.md is binding: one option key ({slug}_theme_options), settings_schema() as single source of truth, sanitize per type on save + escape on output, empty field = default/current content, reset with nonce+confirm (panel option only), cache flush (view cache by version + plugin caches) after every save
hard_requirements.dynamic_data: no hardcoded Persian prose (>= 40 chars) in views: every block is fed from WordPress data/options/WC; docs/content-manifest.md (content extracted from the HTML) is produced by CONV and handed to seeding; QA proves liveness by editing data in admin -> front updates
hard_requirements.woocommerce_templates: store themes: add_theme_support('woocommerce') + override templates under woocommerce/ (archive-product, single-product, cart, checkout incl. thankyou) so real WooCommerce data renders in the HTML design — default WooCommerce templates are a FAIL (standards/woocommerce-integration.md, QA protocol T1-T10)
hard_requirements.content_seeding: every delivery ships a one-click idempotent Seeder (inc/seed/ or content/seed.xml) that builds pages, posts, 8-12 products, CPT records, menus and WooCommerce pages from the HTML content — a fresh install must look like the source HTML (standards/content-seeding.md)
hard_requirements.domain_blueprints: every project starts from config/domain-blueprints.json (20 domain blueprints: pages, home sections, CPTs, seed counts, WooCommerce decision, schema/title): TL loads it at INTAKE, ARCH reconciles with the HTML source (HTML wins), CONV prefills content-manifest, WP builds the seeder from it (knowledge/domain-blueprints.md)
hard_requirements.zero_fatal: zero fatal errors: functions.php = guards only (PHP version + is_file + require_once, admin_notices allowed); every PHP file has ABSPATH guard; no global function/class redeclaration; gated requires for plugin-dependent code; view cache invalidated by theme version; gate = python3 scripts/validate_theme.py release/{slug}/ must exit 0
